anchor.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver one high-fidelity desktop screenshot of Autonomous Finance, a warm precise AP workbench. Flat 2D product UI, approximately 1800 by 1125, extremely sharp readable system-sans text, no browser frame, no perspective. White content, warm off-white #f6f5f1 sidebar, dark ink #1d2320, muted #58635b, thin #d7dbd3 borders, pale green #e3ece1 selection, solid dark green #1f6f4a primary action, restrained amber for missing evidence. NO gradients, marketing hero, chart decorations, emoji, invented metrics, decorative status dots, or lorem ipsum.
Shared shell for the whole series: slim 210px sidebar with Autonomous Finance at top, navigation labels exactly Inbox, Bank & cash, Finance flow, Team, Live activity, Ledger, Memory, Evals, Control room. Inbox is selected throughout this case session. Sidebar footer 'Synthetic company'. Header includes a text link 'Back to inbox', a compact search box, read-only 'Signed in: [role]' (not a role-switch dropdown), and small gray 'Design concept' badge.
Persistent case header exactly 'Golden State Produce' then 'Case AP-1001 / Invoice INV-1001 / USD 662.90'. Four independent compact status fields under it: Evidence, Bill, Payable, Payment. Do NOT render them as a completed stepper. Below the status fields the same tabs in this order: Overview, Evidence & matching, Decisions, Payment, Reconciliation; a 'History' button at the far right opens contextual history. Footer 'Proposed UI / Synthetic case'. Preserve these exact words and case identity across every frame.
The case is a constructed synthetic design fixture. Invoice v1 has four rows: Kale / 6 cases / $38.50 / $231.00; Romaine / 4 cases / $42.75 / $171.00; Avocado / 3 cases / $68.90 / $206.70; Tomato / 1 case / $54.20 / $54.20. Total USD 662.90; terms Net 14. Do not invent real addresses or calendar dates. Source versions and evidence-set revisions are different. Receipt v1 later makes evidence revision 2. Account coding 5000 Cost of goods is illustrative policy for this case only.
Reference image: the attached previous mockup is only a brand/material reference. Substantially revise its navigation and layout according to this specification.
Frame 2: EVIDENCE HOLD. Signed in: AP reviewer. Header statuses: Evidence 'Receipt missing', Bill 'On hold', Payable 'Not posted', Payment 'Not authorized'. Selected tab Evidence & matching.
Main workspace has a broad evidence area split into source viewer on left and line comparison in center, plus a narrower right decision panel. Avoid nesting extra bordered cards inside cards.
Left viewer toolbar 'Invoice v1' and 'Page 1'. Display a realistic plain synthetic invoice with supplier, INV-1001, Net 14, the exact four line amounts above, and total 662.90. Light green highlight on the actual Kale row on the paper. Caption 'Synthetic rendered document'.
Center title 'Compare supporting evidence', subtitle 'Evidence revision 1'. Toggle 'Exceptions only (4)' selected, 'All lines'. A compact table: Item | Invoiced | Received | Check. Four rows: Kale | 6 cases | Unknown | Receipt missing; Romaine | 4 cases | Unknown | Receipt missing; Avocado | 3 cases | Unknown | Receipt missing; Tomato | 1 case | Unknown | Receipt missing. Kale row selected in pale green, corresponding to source highlight. Below rows: 'Prices agree with contract'. 'PO not supplied / Three-way match not verified'. Link 'View contract'. Small plain annotation 'Selected quantity: Invoice v1, page 1'. Below a field 'Delivery reference / Unresolved' with note 'No reliable source region'.
Right panel title 'What is needed' with amber inline alert 'Delivery evidence missing'. Fields 'Owner / Receiving team', 'Required / Goods receipt', 'Effect / Bill approval blocked'. Primary button 'Request receipt'. Secondary text link 'Attach evidence'. Separate plain section 'Agent prepared' listing 'Invoice fields extracted', 'Contract prices checked', 'Receipt still needed'. Bottom of this panel clear text 'Confirming fields does not approve the bill.' outlined button 'Confirm invoice fields'. Nothing implies the receipt exists. Bottom full-width slim history strip 'Latest: invoice added / Evidence revision 1' and text button 'View history'.
Keep density consistent, use short labels and ample reading room, no huge blank areas.
